name: Muhammad ibn Sinan al-Awqi
nameAr: محمد بن سنان الباهلي، أبو بكر البصري، المعروف بالعوقي

nisbas.en: al-Awqi: after al-Awqah, the clan among whom he settled, not his lineage (al-Mizzi: a clan of al-Azd; Ibn Hajar, Hady al-Sari: of Abd al-Qays)

orthography.spelled: al-Awqi: fathah on the ayn and the waw, then qaf (Taqrib). Not to be confused with al-Awfi (sukun on the waw, then fa'), the nisba of the descendants of Abd al-Rahman ibn Awf.
orthography.source: Taqrib al-Tahdhib 5935; Ibn Hajar, Hady al-Sari, fasl 6, letter ayn

taqrib.en: Reliable and firm; of the senior men of the tenth generation.

students.name: Abu Muslim Ibrahim ibn Abdullah al-Kajji, the last to narrate from him

verdicts.source: al-Jarh wa al-Ta'dil 7/279 (Abu Hatim heard from him); Tahdhib al-Kamal 25/320

verdicts.via: Muhammad ibn Abdullah ibn Abi al-Thalj
verdicts.ar: ما رأيت عفان يثني على أحد إلا على محمد بن سنان العوقي، لما بلغه أنه حدث قال: عن مثله فاكتبوا
verdicts.en: "I never saw Affan praise anyone except Muhammad ibn Sinan al-Awqi; when he heard he had begun to teach he said: from such a man, write."

flags.label: Attribution by residence
flags.detail: al-Awqi is not a lineage. Al-Mizzi: "al-Awqah is a quarter of al-Azd; he settled among them and was attributed to them" (Tahdhib al-Kamal 25/320). Ibn Hajar makes al-Awqah a clan of Abd al-Qays (Hady al-Sari, fasl 6). The two differ on the tribe, agree on the point: the nisba records where he lived.

flags.label: Homonym
flags.detail: Not Muhammad ibn Sinan ibn Yazid al-Qazzaz, Abu Bakr al-Basri, resident of Baghdad, who is weak (Taqrib 5936, entered for distinction only).

bio: A Basran shaykh of al-Bukhari and Abu Dawud, reliable by every critic's account, whose nisba al-Awqi comes from the quarter of Basra where he settled rather than from his tribe, which was Bahilah. Al-Bukhari heard the "I have been given five" hadith from him and from Sa'id ibn al-Nadr separately and joined the two routes with the ha' of transition.

provenance.field: nameAr, nisbas (al-Awqah of al-Azd), teachers, students

provenance.ref: Tahdhib al-Tahdhib 3/581, as collected on the Shamela narrator record 5651

provenance.field: al-Awqah of Abd al-Qays; al-Awfi homograph
